notablePrerequisites:
The Merfolk does not have summoning sickness.
There are legal targets for the Merfolk's ability, if applicable.
description:
Activate the Merfolk by tapping it.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
When the Merfolk enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Merfolk's tap ability.
Repeat.
